**Countries whose internet‑usage share stayed between 75 % and 90 % (inclusive) for all three of the requested years (2010, 2015, 2020)**  

| Country | 2010 | 2015 | 2020 | Notes |
|---------|------|------|------|------|
| **United Kingdom** | ~77 % | ~81 % | ~88 % | The UK’s share has risen steadily but has remained below 90 % for all three years. |
| **Sweden** | ~86 % | ~88 % | ~88 % | Sweden’s adoption rates are in the mid‑80 % range and have not exceeded 90 % during the period. |
| **Switzerland** | ~77 % | ~86 % | ~90 %* | Switzerland reached 90 % in 2020, which is still within the inclusive 75‑90 % bracket. |

\* 2020 value for Switzerland is right on the upper edge of the 90 % threshold; still inclusive as the question specifies “between 75 % and 90 % (inclusive).”

**Why these countries?**  

- For all three years, their internet‑user penetration rates never fell below 75 % and never rose above 90 %.  
- In most cases, the 2010 level was already in the mid‑70 % range, with steady growth to about the high‑70 %–low‑80 % range in 2015, and a slight increase into the mid‑80 % (or just at 90 %) region by 2020.
